thesis: Flower canonically states that the organism exists to nourish the human Center-holder, but it lacks a dedicated evidence organ for whether that nourishment is occurring. Economic value and self-improvement are measured more rigorously than personal benefit. Add a Center Dividend membrane that keeps human attention, decision quality, completion/closure, financial utility, capability/optionality, and self-reported meaning/wellbeing separate, refusing a single life score or inferred wellbeing claim.
affectedDecisions: whether another Flower recursion is worth the Center-holder's attention
whether methodology growth is creating personal benefit or merely internal sophistication
which Flower mechanisms deserve continued investment
whether external/economic work is reducing or increasing unresolved personal burden
causalInputs: observable before/after burden or outcome evidence
explicit Center-holder testimony for meaning/wellbeing dimensions
complexityToPreserve: projected financial value is not realized financial utility
meaning, love, identity, fulfillment, and wellbeing cannot be inferred from system activity
different personal-value dimensions are not fungible without human authority
falsifier: If the audit adds recurring reporting burden, encourages life-score optimization, duplicates existing terminal/human-attention governance without changing decisions, or pressures the Center-holder to quantify experiences they prefer to leave qualitative, do not promote it.
rollback: Delete the Center Dividend shadow module/tests and retain the existing invariant that the organism exists to nourish the human Center-holder without adding a dedicated measurement layer.
stoppingCondition: Do not promote until at least one real Center-holder audit changes or confirms an allocation decision with lower burden than the value of the information obtained.
